params.q: What is the health cover amount per family under Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY?

search_parameters.q: What is the health cover amount per family under Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY?

text_blocks.snippet: Under the Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY), the health cover amount is $\mathbf{\$5}$ for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
Key details regarding this coverage include:

list.snippet: Standard Family Cover: Up to ₹5 lakh annually on a family-floater basis, meaning the sum can be utilized by one or all family members.

Senior Citizens (70+): Under recent expansions, senior citizens aged 70 and above receive a distinct card. If they belong to an already covered family, they get an additional top-up cover of up to ₹5 lakh per year exclusively for themselves (not shared with members under 70), while eligible senior citizens in families not previously covered get a standalone ₹5 lakh annual cover.
Inclusions: Pre-existing conditions are covered from day one, alongside pre-hospitalization (3 days) and post-hospitalization (15 days) expenses.
Portability: The coverage is cashless and paperless, and offers nationwide portability across empaneled public and private hospitals.

response.reconstructed_markdown:
Under the Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana \(AB PM\-JAY\), the health cover amount is $\mathbf{\$5}$ for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization. [0]

Key details regarding this coverage include:

- Standard Family Cover: Up to ₹5 lakh annually on a family\-floater basis, meaning the sum can be utilized by one or all family members. [0] [1]
- Senior Citizens \(70\+\): Under recent expansions, senior citizens aged 70 and above receive a distinct card. If they belong to an already covered family, they get an additional top\-up cover of up to ₹5 lakh per year exclusively for themselves \(not shared with members under 70\), while eligible senior citizens in families not previously covered get a standalone ₹5 lakh annual cover. [2]
- Inclusions: Pre\-existing conditions are covered from day one, alongside pre\-hospitalization \(3 days\) and post\-hospitalization \(15 days\) expenses. [0] [1]
- Portability: The coverage is cashless and paperless, and offers nationwide portability across empaneled public and private hospitals. [0] [3]
